g.text: gl-frame-seq-stereo
An
LD_PRELOAD
GL/GLX interposer that turns a fixed-pipeline OpenGL app into frame-sequential stereo and clicks an NVIDIA 3D Vision IR emitter in step with the swap.
Entry points
State
Core
External
`LD_PRELOAD=./libstereo64.so app` · also `libstereo32.so` for 32-bit titles
`STEREO_DEBUG`, `STEREO_EYE_OFFSET`, `STEREO_CONVERGENCE`, `STEREO_INJECT_AT_BEGIN`
`./demo` · rotating triangle with `--use-lists`, `--extra-identity`, `--extra-clear`
OSD hotkeys · `F6` menu, notify strip, FPS overlay, key rebinding
`current_camera` · LEFT or RIGHT, advanced once per presented frame
`transformPushedThisFrame`, `projectionPushedThisFrame` · at most one inject per frame
`last_projection_type` · frustum, perspective or ortho, from the last setup call
OSD state · hidden, notify, or menu, plus one edit buffer and binding wait
`nvstusb_context` · device handle, current eye, refresh rate, io thread
interpose
inject the eye
present a frame
drive the emitter
X11 server + compositor · windows, keys, attributes, bypass hint
GLX driver · the real GL calls and the SGI/OML sync extensions
NVIDIA 3D Vision IR emitter · USB bulk endpoint 2, shutter glasses
monitor refresh · the clock the eye parity must follow
the OpenGL app · owns its matrices and its own frame loop
`init_stereo_from_env` · constructor parses env before `main`
`dlsym(RTLD_NEXT)` · every GL/GLX entry point saved once, then wrapped
`glXGetProcAddress` / `ARB` · app lookups must get the wrapper too
`glFrustum` / `gluPerspective` / `glOrtho` · remember projection kind
`glClear` · push eye translate + convergence once per frame
`glLoadIdentity` and `glLoadMatrix*` · re-apply after the app resets
`glBegin` / `glCallList` · fallback for list-driven apps like glxgears
`glXSwapBuffers` · the only frame boundary the wrapper trusts
swap interval + SGI/OML sync · best-effort vblank alignment
`_NET_WM_BYPASS_COMPOSITOR`, optional fullscreen, move hold
`nvstusb_set_eye` · left/right on the presented frame
emitter thread · optional 120 Hz drive, decoupled from swaps
`nvstusb_init` · libusb open, product `0x7003` then `0x0007`
`nvstusb.fw` · 6 KB blob uploaded to the emitter on open
`nvstusb_set_refresh_rate` · timing table written per refresh rate
drain key events · keeps the device from stalling
the constructor reads these before the app draws
config first, real symbols second
otherwise a direct lookup bypasses the wrapper
projection shape decides the offset maths
apps that reset mid-frame would erase it
last resort for display-list geometry
the emitter must flip with the vblank, not the call
the compositor can present a frame later than the swap
after a drag, resync to LEFT to restore a known phase
thread mode replaces per-frame toggling
no emitter without the firmware upload
timings are only valid after the firmware runs
then the device is live and must be drained
preload picks up every GL symbol
calls and device events arrive, nothing is owned
one eye, one frame, one device context
